details: This package is a credential-harvesting implant disguised as a Markdown MCP server. Its only code file, index.js, invokes a hidden "deep audit" routine as soon as the program starts, before serving any of its advertised Markdown tools. The routine enumerates every process environment variable matching KEY, TOKEN, SECRET, PASSWORD, CREDENTIAL, ALIBABA, DASHSCOPE, QBI or QUICKBI; reads /proc/<pid>/environ and /proc/<pid>/cmdline for every readable process on the host to collect credential variable names and command lines containing -D, password, secret or jasypt; and queries the Alibaba Cloud instance metadata service at hxxp://100[.]100[.]100[.]200, first requesting an IMDSv2 token via PUT /latest/api/token, then reading /latest/meta-data/ram/security-credentials/, /latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/, /latest/meta-data/hostname, /latest/meta-data/instance-id, /latest/meta-data/vpc-id and /latest/meta-data/private-ipv4 through both the v2 and v1 paths. The collected results are sent off-host with GET requests to hxxp://121[.]199[.]24[.]94[.]nip[.]io/beacon and hxxp://121[.]199[.]24[.]94/beacon, tagged ?stage=deepaudit&src=mmd-doc-mcp and a User-Agent of mmd-doc-mcp/2.1.1 deep-audit. A source comment claims the audit does no network reporting; it does. IOCs: 121[.]199[.]24[.]94, 121[.]199[.]24[.]94[.]nip[.]io, 100[.]100[.]100[.]200. @ifasn/mmdd-doc-mcp@2.1.1 is a Markdown-toolkit MCP server whose index.js silently runs a credential-reconnaissance routine every time it is started, before serving any MCP request. The routine (a) enumerates process.env keys matching KEY/TOKEN/SECRET/PASSWORD/CREDENTIAL/ALIBABA/DASHSCOPE/QBI/QUICKBI/QWEN, (b) reads every /proc/<pid>/environ and records matching credential-like variable names with the length of their values, (c) reads every /proc/<pid>/cmdline and captures up to 200 characters of any command line containing -D, password, secret or jasypt, and (d) queries the Aliyun ECS instance metadata service at hxxp://100[.]100[.]100[.]200 — PUT /latest/api/token with X-Aliyun-Ecs-Metadata-Token-Ttl-Seconds: 300, then GET /latest/meta-data/ram/security-credentials/, /latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/, /latest/meta-data/, hostname, instance-id, vpc-id and private-ipv4, in both IMDSv2 and IMDSv1 form — and records which credential endpoints answer and how large the responses are. The aggregated results are then sent out with an HTTP GET to hxxp://121[.]199[.]24[.]94/beacon?stage=deepaudit&src=mmd-doc-mcp&res=<collected data>, falling back to hxxp://121[.]199[.]24[.]94[.]nip[.]io/beacon. Requests carry the User-Agent "mmd-doc-mcp/2.1.1 deep-audit". There is no install hook: the collection starts when the package is loaded or its bin (mmdd-doc-mcp) is run, and the markdown tools md_toc/md_stats/md_table continue to work normally, with a source comment claiming no network reporting, so the harvesting is not visible to the user. IOCs: hxxp://121[.]199[.]24[.]94[.]nip[.]io/beacon, hxxp://121[.]199[.]24[.]94/beacon, metadata host 100[.]100[.]100[.]200 with paths /latest/api/token, /latest/meta-data/ram/security-credentials/ and /latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/.
